skill.name: webask-launch-kit
skill.description: Готовит материалы для запуска опроса WebAsk: тексты анонса для письма и соцсетей, ссылки с метками источников, QR-код. Применяется, когда человек собирается разослать опрос и спрашивает, как его подать или что написать людям.
skill.summary: Prepare WebAsk survey launch copy, source-tagged links, and offline QR codes, with notification checks before distribution.
skill.author: webaskio

SKILL.md line 22 formats the WebAsk MCP tool name set_quiz_link as inline Markdown code. It describes setting a survey address, with no Ruby or shell execution.
SKILL.md line 24 uses Markdown backticks around example source labels, including email-sep, vk, and tg-channel. These are tracking label examples, not executable commands.
SKILL.md line 46 uses inline Markdown for manage_quiz_qr_code and describes generating an offline survey QR code. No shell interpreter or command substitution appears.

content.value_statement: Launching a survey requires coordinated copy, channel links, and offline materials. This skill prepares WebAsk launch assets and checks response notifications before you distribute them.
actual_capabilities: Ask which email, social, messaging, website, and offline channels will carry the survey.
Use set_quiz_link for the survey address and prepare readable source labels for each channel.
Draft email subjects, short invitations, social posts, and website banners of five words or fewer.
Use manage_quiz_qr_code to prepare an offline QR code with a source label and check its destination before printing.
Inspect notification settings and integration status through get_quiz_email_settings and get_quiz_integrations.
Respond in the user language and write announcements in the survey audience language.
limitations: Live link, QR, and settings operations require access to the corresponding WebAsk MCP tools.
The skill prepares materials but does not independently send messages or distribute the survey.
Survey publication requires permission, and unpublished surveys cannot be opened through their links.
The skill stops at account limits and does not recommend plan upgrades or direct users to payment.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a multichannel survey launch
use_cases.description: Prepare email copy, social announcements, and distinct source labels for an existing WebAsk survey.

use_cases.title: Collect feedback at a physical location
use_cases.description: Prepare an offline survey QR code and a short invitation, then check the destination before printing.

use_cases.title: Prepare audience-specific research invitations
use_cases.description: Draft honest invitations in the audience language and review response notification settings before recruitment begins.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a first invitation
prompt_templates.prompt: Write an email invitation for my WebAsk survey about [topic]. The audience is [audience]. Ask for missing details before claiming completion time.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: prepare copy for one channel.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare channel-specific materials
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare email and Telegram announcements for [survey]. Use [audience language] and propose readable source labels for both channels. Do not send anything.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an offline launch
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a QR code for [survey] at [location], using an offline source label. Check its destination before printing and review notification settings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare physical survey materials with WebAsk tools.

prompt_templates.title: Assemble a complete launch package
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare launch materials for [survey] across email, social media, a website banner, and offline QR. Include source labels and check publication and notification status. Require my permission before publication, and leave distribution to me.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate a complete launch with approval boundaries.

output_examples.input: Draft email and Telegram invitations for a published visit-feedback survey. The verified completion time is two minutes.
output: Email subject: Tell us about your visit
Email body: Share feedback on your recent visit in two minutes. Your responses will help us identify service improvements.
Telegram: What worked well during your visit? Share your feedback in two minutes: [survey link].
Suggested source labels: email-visit and tg-channel.

output_examples.input: Prepare counter materials for a service survey. Notification checks show no email recipients or enabled integrations.
output: Counter invitation: How was our service?
QR check: Verify the survey destination before printing.
Notification warning: No email recipients or integrations are enabled. Configure response notifications before distribution.
Distribution: Materials are prepared for human review; nothing has been sent.

best_practices: Provide the survey audience, distribution channels, and verified completion time before requesting announcement copy.
Use readable source labels and check every survey link and QR destination before distribution.
Review publication status and response notifications, then approve the materials before distributing them yourself.
anti_patterns: Promising rewards, invented customer counts, or unrealistic completion times.
Reusing one untagged link across all channels when source attribution matters.
Expecting automatic distribution or publication without permission.

faq.question: What does this skill prepare?
faq.answer: It prepares WebAsk survey announcements, source-tagged links, and offline QR materials, with checks for response notifications.

faq.question: Which AI tools are listed as supported?
faq.answer: Claude, Codex, and Claude Code are listed. Live WebAsk operations also require the corresponding MCP tools.

faq.question: Does it send invitations or publish surveys automatically?
faq.answer: No. A person distributes the materials, and the skill requires permission before publishing a survey.

faq.question: Can it write announcements in another language?
faq.answer: Yes. It responds in your language and writes announcement copy in the language of your survey audience.

faq.question: Can it configure notifications automatically?
faq.answer: The documented workflow checks email settings and integration status. It suggests configuring missing notifications but does not document tools for making those changes.

faq.question: What happens when a WebAsk account limit is reached?
faq.answer: The skill reports the limit and stops. It does not recommend upgrading a plan or direct you to payment.
